text:
B: Hello! Can you hear me?
A: Yeah. Alright. Craig.
B: Tereza. Nice to meet you. Erm, you are in Swindon, I think? Somebody said.
A: Yeah. Swindon.
B: I'm in Leyton, East London. Have you had a long evening of calls?
A: Yeah. Five of them. You're the last.
B: Me too, you're my last. [laughs] I'm a bit tired of talking about myself now.
A: Yeah.
B: Erm... I saw the headphones behind you, the gaming ones. My husband's friends are always on the PlayStation, shouting.
A: I'm on PC. Racing sims. I don't shout. Mic off.
B: [laughs] Okay, so you are the good kind of gamer. What is your job, sorry?
A: Quality inspection. Measuring parts on a CMM. Checking they're in tolerance, writing reports.
B: Oh, so you find the mistakes. That's like me, I'm clinical trials coordinator. I find the missing signature, the wrong date. Everybody hates me a little bit before audits.
A: Yeah, sort of the same. Nobody likes the inspection bloke when the batch fails.
B: Exactly! And what happens if something is very close, almost wrong?
A: Er, depends. If the manager wants it out, it usually goes out. Bit borderline, it's fine.
B: Oh. For us, no, we cannot do that. If it's wrong, it's a deviation, we have to report it, even very small.
A: Yeah, no, that's fair. It's people with you, isn't it. Mine's bits of aluminium.
B: Yes, that's true. Maybe I'm too strict. Tom says I'm too strict about everything. [laughs] Erm, does that make sense?
A: Yeah. Makes sense.
B: Do you have holidays planned? I plan mine months before, I'm a little bit crazy.
A: Tenerife, maybe. September. Same place I've been three times.
B: Three times, the same hotel? Why the same?
A: Know what you're getting. Pool, bar, decent weather. Don't have to think about it.
B: Actually I understand that. No surprises. I like no surprises.
A: Yeah. That's it really.
B: Do you watch any sport? I only watch ice hockey when Czechia plays, and I cry when we lose. Every time.
A: F1 on a Sunday. Swindon Town. They lose most weeks, so...
B: [laughs] Tom's team also, always losing. I don't even know—
